title: Can I ask You a Question

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't see you. Was in my own little world there. I'm Zee. Least I still remember my name, right? Is there something I can do for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't see you. Was in my own little world there. I'm Zee. Least I still remember my name, right? Is there something I can do for you?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: You'd think so, but I seem to be doing it more and more lately. This spot is perfect for it. I mean, look at that. Despite what people think of it, Nivalis is a beautiful city. It's... well, can I ask you something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'd think so, but I seem to be doing it more and more lately. This spot is perfect for it. I mean, look at that. Despite what people think of it, Nivalis is a beautiful city. It's... well, can I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Oh, nothing... Just, well, can I ask you something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, nothing... Just, well, can I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I'm sorry. You probably just came up to admire the view and here I am assuming you want to talk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry. You probably just came up to admire the view and here I am assuming you want to talk.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: It's amazing the Grid hasn't warped that too. I'll see ya around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's amazing the Grid hasn't warped that too. I'll see ya around.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Well, I'll see ya around then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I'll see ya around then.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Where's your favorite place in Nivalis?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where's your favorite place in Nivalis?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Well, yes. Unless you've figured out how to break through it. Not that you'd want to. Have you been on the feeds since that killer started sneaking around?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, yes. Unless you've figured out how to break through it. Not that you'd want to. Have you been on the feeds since that killer started sneaking around?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: That's what they say, anyway. Apparently someone leaked the crime scene photos in the feeds. I haven't looked at them though. Can't really bring myself to. I'd much rather be up here, lost in this view. Ignorance truly is bliss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what they say, anyway. Apparently someone leaked the crime scene photos in the feeds. I haven't looked at them though. Can't really bring myself to. I'd much rather be up here, lost in this view. Ignorance truly is bliss.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: That's good. Neither am I really. If there is one, and they find me up here, at least I have a clean jump into the sea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's good. Neither am I really. If there is one, and they find me up here, at least I have a clean jump into the sea.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: There's beauty everywhere if you know to look for it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's beauty everywhere if you know to look for it.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: You can even find it in nothing at all. A space void of stimuli and overburdened connections.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can even find it in nothing at all. A space void of stimuli and overburdened connections.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Can I ask you something else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I ask you something else?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I hope I'm here when you do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope I'm here when you do.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Have you ever heard of a place that doesn't have access to the Grid? A place where the Nets don't reach?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever heard of a place that doesn't have access to the Grid? A place where the Nets don't reach?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: No, not like that. I mean a place with pure disconnection. No access to the Grid what-so-ever. I can't stop thinking about what that would do to someone, whether they'd be happier. Guess we'll never really know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, not like that. I mean a place with pure disconnection. No access to the Grid what-so-ever. I can't stop thinking about what that would do to someone, whether they'd be happier. Guess we'll never really know.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I've just heard stories. Every time I try to see if they're true or not they end before I can find out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've just heard stories. Every time I try to see if they're true or not they end before I can find out.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Maybe. It was good talking to you. I hope you stop by again. Not many people appreciate this view.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe. It was good talking to you. I hope you stop by again. Not many people appreciate this view.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Oh, yes. The smell of fresh ingredients. Sounds of bowls and plates and utensils clanging together. There's beauty in food, and the connections we make while eating it. There's beauty everywhere if you know where to look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, yes. The smell of fresh ingredients. Sounds of bowls and plates and utensils clanging together. There's beauty in food, and the connections we make while eating it. There's beauty everywhere if you know where to look.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Sometimes more isn't better. You can find beauty everywhere, sometimes more so in the little things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sometimes more isn't better. You can find beauty everywhere, sometimes more so in the little things.

nodes.text: Isn't it kind of hard to space out in a city this loud?

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Isn't it kind of hard to space out in a city this loud?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: What is it?

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It is a nice view.

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No worries. It happens.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wasn't aware any part of this city could be someone's favorite.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wasn't aware any part of this city could be someone's favorite.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Inside the Localised Unity Zone?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Inside the Localised Unity Zone?

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: My apartment, if it were bigger.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not worried about it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not worried about it.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Everywhere?

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds... kind of terrifying.
